teacher.revision_status: Not exposed by the agent environment

source.kind: original synthetic agent-authored reviews and teacher labels

generation_settings.method: Existing agent text generation; Python renders fixed authored cases and deterministic option rotation
generation_settings.unknown_settings: Teacher sampling parameters and immutable model revision were not exposed
generation_settings.option_order: For 3 options global row index modulo 3; for every tenth row 4 options with four-way rotation; other option order alternates

usage_constraints.origin: Original synthetic situations, no external datasets or private real records
usage_constraints.terms: Generated through existing provider access and subject to existing provider terms; no separately asserted redistribution license

cost.existing_access: Existing agent access only; no additional billed calls or compute

label_strategy: Teacher-authored target labels; no executable semantic rule audit and no independent correctness verification
limitations: Small synthetic English-only pilot; not representative of natural review frequency or writing styles
Explicit evaluative language and explicit mixed conclusions make some cases easier than ordinary reviews
Same teacher authored and reviewed the labels; self-review is not independent verification
Distinct validation domains do not eliminate shared phrasing or sentiment vocabulary across splits
Each group deliberately covers favorable, unfavorable, factual-neutral, and mixed situations; balanced authoring is not a real-world class prior
Mixed cases receive a mixed option; most other 3-option cases use positive, negative, neutral. This candidate-set pattern is an authoring shortcut, not proof of generalization
No sarcasm, implicit emotion, cultural variation, or genuinely unresolved ambiguity is represented
